o1: Enables epidermal growth factor receptor binding activity and receptor signaling protein adaptor activity. Involved in excretory system development; male genitalia development; vulval fate specification; regulation of vulval development; P12 fate specification; epidermal growth factor receptor signaling pathway; and Ras protein signal transduction. Predicted to be located in membrane. Predicted to be part of COP9 signalosome. Predicted to be active in cytoplasm, nucleoplasm, and plasma membrane. Is expressed in P3.p hermaphrodite; P4.p hermaphrodite; P5.p hermaphrodite; P6.p hermaphrodite; and P7.p hermaphrodite. Is part of Ras protein signal transduction. Human ortholog(s) of this gene implicated in autosomal recessive nonsyndromic deafness 114; breast cancer; prostate adenocarcinoma; and prostate cancer. Orthologous to several human genes including GRB2 (growth factor receptor bound protein 2).
